mechanism_claims.claim_text: Plantaricin LPL-1 is characterized as a class IIa bacteriocin with a YGNGV motif and cysteine-containing mature peptide sequence; this supports AMP identity/classification, not a cellular target claim.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Class assignment and sequence evidence do not by themselves identify a complete killing mechanism.
